name: zen-notes-widget
description: A lean multi-note sticky-note widget for the Zen Browser sidebar with workspace-aware storage
author: jjspscl
features: Workspace-aware note collections with active note switching
Lean pinned sidebar widget above workspace indicators
Quick new note flow that replaces the pinned active note
Manager screen for rename, reorder, and hard delete
Legacy single-note migration into the v2 data model
